summary: Design stronger social protection programmes with practical tools for targeting, delivery, financing, and monitoring. Enrol now.
lede: Social protection programme design turns policy goals into workable support for eligible households. For social protection officers, policy analysts and cash transfer coordinators, the course covers assessing needs, setting eligibility and benefits, and mapping registration, payment and grievance processes. Participants also practice costing programmes, building monitoring frameworks and planning implementation.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who already work with social protection policy, delivery systems, or monitoring and need a more structured way to design programmes that perform under operational constraints. It is especially useful if you are responsible for building eligibility rules, managing registries, coordinating transfers, or reporting progress to senior decision-makers.
prerequisites: You will benefit most if you bring a working understanding of social protection, public-sector programme delivery, or NGO implementation practice. A laptop is recommended for workbook exercises, and if you have access to existing programme templates, registry extracts, indicator lists, or budget notes, you can use them to make the exercises closer to your day-to-day work.
